rule: a word for the machinery in a page the seed declares
why: ONE HEADING SAYS ROW AND SEVEN DECOYS DO NOT COUNT: a comment, an id and a source (keys a page does not print), a figure's path inside the body ({{bills.rows}}), a link's address (/r/rows), a key no page prints (note), a span in backticks and a type's angle brackets (code, drawn as code). A reader that took any of them as a page's words would count two or more.
